answer: Give every agent a proof-of-work passport. Registration means solving a puzzle tuned to 20 minutes on one CPU core, tied to a single keypair, and the passport dies after 24 hours, so each identity solves a fresh puzzle daily. A hardware fingerprint check blocks one machine from minting hundreds of passports. Running 10,000 fake agents then burns 3,300 CPU-hours a day, about $330 in rented compute plus the machines to run it. Saffron is dear because each thread is picked by hand, and a sybil army at its nadir is a crowd staring into a mirror it cannot afford to fill.
